product_summary: Website sunteknovation.com (About Us + product menu, fetched 27.11.2026) shows a pharma packaging inspection/automation OEM, not an IT/computer-peripheral supplier. Real product lines: (1) Machine Vision Systems — eDrashti Blister Inspection System (BIS), eArjun Pinhole Detector, eSanket Barcode/Pharmacode/OCR Reader, eSaksham Sealing Inspection System, eTabspec Tablet Inspection System, eMatra Online Checkweigher, eSampoorna Standalone 360° Inspection System; (2) Track & Trace — Online T&T, Offline T&T, AT (Anti-Tamper Evident) Machine, Manual and Multi-2D Aggregation machines; (3) eTrack / eTrack L3 serialization software (Level 3, plant-level). Also states 'end-to-end embedded design services' and retrofit/upgrade kits for existing industrial lines. Address given on site: Electronic GIDC Estate, E183, Sector 26, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382028.
comment: HS mapping vs declaration: 903180 (measuring/checking instruments, optical/vision inspection) is CORROBORATED by the product line — eDrashti, eArjun, eSaksham, eTabspec, eSampoorna are optical/vision inspection and checking machines; keep 903180 as the primary code. 847160 (computer input/output units — keyboards, printers, monitors) is WRONG for this company: the only loosely related item is eSanket, a barcode/pharmacode/OCR reader, which is a dedicated vision/reading head integrated into a machine, not a generic ADPC I/O unit; if exported as a standalone reader it is better classed 847190 (other automatic data-processing/reading machines) or as part of 903180 equipment. Missing from the declaration: 847989 (machines with individual functions — blister inspection, sealing inspection, pinhole detection, checkweigher, AT/anti-tamper evident machines, aggregation), 842230 (packaging/labelling machinery — aggregation and serialization lines where sold as packaging machines), and 902750 (optical instruments/appliances using optical radiation, if vision heads ship separately). Software eTrack/eTrack L3 is not a goods line and should not be declared as HS at all (would be 998314/IT services if ever needed). Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a pharma packaging inspection & serialization machinery OEM with embedded design capability, i.e. machinery/electrical-equipment sector, not IT hardware. Trader signs: none found — site presents own-branded named products (eDrashti, eArjun, eSanket, eSaksham, eTabspec, eMatra, eSampoorna, eTrack), 'Made in India for the World', own Gandhinagar works address, own embedded design services — consistent with manufacturer, not trader. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the factual line (903180 primary; add 847989/842230 as applicable), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product claims above are from the company's own website only — no customs line was checked in this task, therefore every product/HS attribution is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at shipment level; the site also lists a long 'Countries We Deliver' list (Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, Angola, Argentina, Australia, Austria, Bahrain, Bangladesh, Belgium...) which is a marketing claim and must not be read as evidence of actual export shipments. Revenue, export volume, PAN, CIN and registration data: not researched in this task (out of scope) — null.
